name: Bodal Chemicals Ltd
about: Bodal Chemicals Limited is one of India’s leading integrated Dyestuff companies and is the largest domestic manufacturer of Dye Intermediates. It offers a wide range of Dyestuffs, Dye Intermediates, Basic Chemicals, and its variants to diverse customers across India and the world. [1]
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio (200+ products)[1]
Basic Chemicals (12 products) 
Dye Intermediates (25 products) 
Dyestuffs (175 products) 
Chlor Alkali (6 products) 
New Product Addition: Benzene Derivatives  (5 products)

pros: Stock is trading at 0.62 times its book value
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 29.3 days to 19.9 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.88% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.38% over last 3 years.
Dividend payout has been low at 1.10% of profits over last 3 years
